title: Informational and Noninformational Advertising Content
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. All regressions (Tables 7-9, Code.do) are linear probability models of consumer-level survey outcomes (awareness, consideration, purchase) on continuous brand-DMA-month advertising spending (advertising) or on content-specific spending (informational, noninformational, bothcontents, missing), with brand x DMA, brand x state x month, brand x wave x online x demographic FE (border-DMA variant with brand x border x month FE), plus state_dependence and price_ind regressors in the purchase stage. Treatment is a continuous intensity, not a binary switch-on.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe, pweight sampleweight, cluster new_dma. Two datasets: Data-complete-sample.dta and Data-border-sample.dta. Identification from within-brand-DMA variation in ad spending and DMA border discontinuities.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous advertising spending regressor; additional time-varying regressors (state_dependence, price_ind) in purchase stage

data_files_note: Readme.txt: data protected by NDA, so the authors provide fake datasets instead.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract (no article text, no PDF). code_prescore 2 is driven by reghdfe with DMA and month FE; the regressor is continuous ad spending.
